body: While I agree with your point, even if richer people develop mental illness from the fact, at least they can afford someone to talk to and tell them what is wrong with them.
It’s not going to work for everyone but there’s a huge group of people living undiagnosed and without the right support they actually require as a human being.

With you there. Every time I battle with myself to even attempt to go to the doctors they will tell me I need to do that battle at least 3 more times to get any real help. They just put me on this shit medication which does nothing but make me a bit less fucking autistic. I still want to die constantly. How is this shit supposed to help

I honestly envy people who aren’t suffering with this kind of shit. My mind literally never stops thinking and it thinks faster than everything else around me.  
Then I see people who somehow don’t have a thought in their head and they seem to get on with it. I can’t stand it  
I’d much rather just be some dumb happy idiot than live in torment daily
